svg.title: Archaeologist — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as archaeologist, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A narrow excavation trowel stands beside a broken, flared pottery rim and curved vessel fragment. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
